summary: Guardian Metal Resources PLC filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release and a TR-1 notification of major holdings. Purebond Limited crossed the 5% voting rights threshold on 17 June 2026, now holding 5.004928% (9,750,000 shares) directly. No tender, acquisition, divestiture, or special-situation event is announced. The filing is a routine regulatory disclosure of a shareholder's position change under UK rules, equivalent to a Schedule 13D/A filing in the US. There are no deal terms, board recommendation, or event-driven catalyst to track.
